title: Faith in action: serving communities across Canada
body:
EXAMPLE NEWSLETTER
This sample issue shows how a Mercy for Humanity newsletter could look. It is not a report of completed events. Dates, venues, charity partners, and registration details are still to be confirmed.

Service inspired by faith
Mercy for Humanity is a Canadian initiative of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Elders Association. Inspired by the example of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), our charitable work puts the Islamic teachings of compassion and service into practice, welcoming people of every faith and background.

One purpose, communities across Canada
Our regional runs and walks offer a shared way to take part. Run for Windsor, Run for Guelph, and Run for Hamilton in Ontario, alongside Run for Edmonton in Alberta, bring the focus to local communities, with the same purpose: serving humanity through charity.

Whether you prefer to run or walk, the aim is to take part together. Each regional page will share confirmed event details when they are available. The photographs in this example show community participation at charity runs; they are used across the website while regional event information is prepared.

Give your time
Volunteers can help welcome participants, support event setup, and share stories from their Canadian communities. If you would like to help, visit the Volunteer page to explore the roles.

Stay connected
Sign up using the form in the footer to join our newsletter list. Future issues can share confirmed run details, volunteering opportunities, and stories of service from our communities.

Every step. Every act. For humanity.
